source_challenge.point: Genuine caller, not an invented later Unlock
source_challenge.finding: Confirm launches one original ViewModel job; exists -> create -> ensureActive -> automatic unlock. Completion clears detached password. clearForLock cancels that job. No explicit interstage yield is present or needed to posit the concurrent prefix.

Create holds transition, operation and session mutexes. requestLock uses the SAME session mutex, not an independent shortcut mutex; a terminal lock can register its separate intent while waiting behind create. After actual insert/create publishes Locked(null), the queued Default waiter can take the null-key/Locked fastpath, avoid transition/completeLock, and retire its intent before Main reaches ordinary unlock admission. This is a possible order, not guaranteed scheduling.

source_challenge.point: Successful terminal helper adds no hidden retry delay
source_challenge.finding: Default lock reason is Manual. A successful lock returns immediately; the existing bounded helper retries/delays only failure branches. No new retry or timing gate is proposed.

source_challenge.point: Cancellation and native close are distinct
source_challenge.finding: Terminal close starts cleanup then exits composition without the UI-ACK helper. The actual session observer would clear/cancel onboarding if it processes the reasoned lock. Source does not guarantee that delivery before disposal or superseding state. Busy Back is guarded, but native Window close is separate; disposal unregisters Back/native listeners rather than invoking beforePop.

source_challenge.point: No all-schedules guard disproof or lifetime overclaim
source_challenge.finding: Named bindings contain no explicit terminal clear of the singleton onboarding ViewModel. Cancelling the separately injected application scope is not itself source proof of cancellation of that ViewModel job. This neither proves a permanent leak nor authorizes ignoring prompt cancellation, real process death or library lifetime behavior.

source_challenge.point: Real Room is an unresolved competing barrier
source_challenge.finding: Pending intent rejects snapshot; later generation change rejects verify/commit. Metadata/KDF/update failure or cancellation also defeats publication. Real checkpointAndClose uses a separate bootstrap mutex; openSession has no explicit shutdown check after successful DAO return, but annotations/source alone do not prove that installed Room permits the required return/close/continuation order. Successful full tail remains unobserved.
